hero.title: Carried home.
hero.lead: In myth, Arion carried his rider home when every battle was lost. We build shoes with the same promise: we get to know your foot first, then we make your shoe. And we stay with it for as long as it lives.
hero.kicker: A shoe is a contract of carriage.

myth.title: A child of earth and water, a horse of legendary speed.
myth.body: In Greek myth, Arion is the son of Poseidon, god of the sea, and Demeter, goddess of the earth. When the army fell in the war of the Seven against Thebes, Arion's speed alone carried King Adrastus out alive. Every part of the myth maps to one of our promises.
myth.tableCaption: Traits from the myth and what they mean at ARION

carrier.myth: Carries his rider home safely from battle
carrier.promise: A shoe is a contract of carriage. It carries you home, whatever the conditions.

earthWater.promise: Winter boots and outdoor shoes that grip the ground and stand up to water

speed.promise: Sneakers and movement: The Physics of Motion

immortal.promise: Repairability, the Lifetime Plan and the Shoe Passport

fitTwin.title: Same size. Different foot.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.lead: In myth, Arion carried his rider home when every battle was lost. That is how we see shoes.

paragraphs.p1: A shoe is the only interface between your foot and the world. It carries your whole weight thousands of times a day. So we treat it not as a fashion object but as a contract of carriage.
paragraphs.p2: We explain why every model is built the way it is. We measure our claims. When a shoe wears out, we call it back to the atelier, not to the bin.
paragraphs.p3: Türkiye cannot win a price war on cheap production. The way to win is added value: design, fit technology, craft and direct cross-border e-commerce.

manifesto.quote: Efsanede Arion, savaş kaybedildiğinde bile sahibini eve taşıdı. Biz ayakkabıyı aynı sözle yaparız.

fit.title: Foot first
fit.body: A size is a label, not a measurement. We calculate fit in millimetres.

explain.title: Explain
explain.body: Every technical claim comes with an answer to "How did we measure this?"

repair.title: Repair
repair.body: Welted soles, replaceable heel tips, resoling. A longer life is a design decision.

categories.topuklu: As heel height rises, weight shifts to the forefoot. The shank, the heel axis and the forefoot cushion are there to manage that load.
categories.kislik-bot: A waterproof membrane, a gusseted tongue and rubber that stays flexible in the cold. A welted sole, so it can be repaired.
categories.sneaker: Midsole cushioning and energy return, heel-to-toe drop and a flex line that bends in the right place.
categories.klasik: A leather sole that shapes itself to your foot and a welted build that can be resoled. Made to last a lifetime.
categories.cocuk: A flexible sole, a wide toe box and room to grow. Measuring reminders as the foot grows.

anatomy.lead: Separate the layers and see what each part does.

upper.name: Upper
upper.desc: The surface that wraps the foot. Leather or textile; it should breathe and hold its shape.

lining.name: Lining
lining.desc: The inside of the upper. Reduces friction and moves moisture away.

membrane.name: Waterproof membrane
membrane.desc: Between upper and lining; keeps water out while letting vapour escape.

insole.name: Insole
insole.desc: Where the foot rests; it takes the shape of your foot over time.

shank.name: Shank
shank.desc: A stiff strip under the arch; stops the shoe folding in the middle and spreads the load in heels.

midsole.name: Midsole
midsole.desc: The cushioning layer. Foam in sneakers, a thin leather filler in classics.

outsole.name: Outsole
outsole.desc: The part that meets the ground: grip, wear and repairability are decided here.

heel.name: Heel
heel.desc: Carries the centre of gravity. Its height and angle directly affect balance.

tongue.name: Tongue
tongue.desc: Spreads lace pressure and protects the top of the foot.

laces.name: Laces
laces.desc: Adjust the upper to the volume of your foot; they matter with a high arch.

straps.name: Hook-and-loop straps
straps.desc: So children can put them on and take them off themselves.

accent.name: Mane line
accent.desc: ARION's side accent; a demo reflective material.

topuklu.title: Heels: engineered balance
points: Centre of gravity: the higher the heel, the more load shifts to the forefoot, so the last is kept wider there.
Heel angle: the heel tip is set at the angle that puts it right under the centre of gravity.
Shank: a steel strip carries the arch and stops the shoe collapsing in the middle.

kislik-bot.title: Winter boots: dry inside, grippy outside
points: The membrane sits between upper and lining; seams are sealed with tape.
Stitch line: where sole meets upper is the weakest point for water, so it is double stitched.
Lugs: deep, spaced lugs shed snow and mud.

sneaker.title: Sneakers: light and responsive
points: Midsole foam absorbs impact and returns energy.
The heel lock stops the foot sliding while the forefoot stays free.
The outsole is only thickened where it wears.

klasik.title: Classics: built to be resoled
points: The Goodyear welt lets a new sole be fitted without separating the upper.
The leather insole takes the shape of your foot over time.
The shank supports the arch on long walks.

cocuk.title: Kids: room for growing feet
points: A wide toe box lets the toes move freely.
A flexible outsole doesn't fight the natural bend of each step.
The last includes 12 mm of growing room.

viewer.arHint: AR works on phones and tablets: Scene Viewer opens on Android, Quick Look on iPhone. On desktop you can rotate and inspect the model.

meanings.flex_cycles: How many times the sole can bend without cracking. Higher means a longer-lasting sole.
meanings.abrasion: Volume of material lost in a standard rubbing test. Lower means slower wear.
meanings.waterproof_hours: How long the shoe stays dry inside while flexing under water.
meanings.slip_wet: Slip resistance coefficient on wet floors. Higher means better grip.
meanings.slip_dry: Slip resistance coefficient on dry floors.
meanings.weight: Total weight of a pair. Lightness isn't a priority in every category.
meanings.heel_stability: How far the heel splays sideways under load. Lower means a steadier heel.

durability.compareLead: The same tests don't carry the same weight in every category.

replies.men: The men's salon has classics such as Adrastus Oxford, Castor Loafer, Pollux Derby and Herakles Chelsea, plus boots and sneakers.

method.title: How would you like to measure?
method.manualHint: A sheet of paper, a pen and a ruler. About 3 minutes.
method.paperHint: Stand on an A4 sheet and take a photo. The photo is processed only in your browser and never uploaded.

length.title: Foot length
steps: Place the paper on the floor against a wall and put your heel against the wall.
Stand with your weight on that foot and mark the tip of your longest toe.
Measure from the wall to the mark in millimetres. Measure both feet and use the larger one.
length.label: Length (mm)
length.hint: Example: 26.5 cm = 265 mm. Measuring in the evening gives more accurate results.

width.title: Forefoot width
steps: With your foot on the paper, mark the two widest points across the big-toe and little-toe joints.
Measure the distance between the marks in millimetres.
width.label: Width (mm)
width.girthHint: Wrap a tape measure around the widest part. Leave empty if unsure.

arch.title: Arch profile
arch.hint: Step on paper with a wet foot and look at the print. This is not a health assessment; it only helps choose the upper volume.
arch.flatHint: Most of the print is visible
arch.normalHint: The middle of the print clearly narrows
arch.highHint: A thin strip between heel and forefoot

preference.title: How do you like shoes to feel?

paper.title: A4 method
paper.intro: Place your foot on an A4 sheet with your heel touching the short edge. Take a photo from above with all four corners of the paper visible.
paper.local: The photo is processed on your device; it is not uploaded and is discarded when you leave the page.
paper.instructions: Tap in order: the 4 corners of the paper (top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left), heel, tip of the longest toe, and the two widest points of the forefoot.
paper.canvasLabel: Area for marking points on the photo

topuklu: Replace the heel tip before it wears to the line.
Moisturise leather monthly; only brush suede.
Store with a shoe tree to keep the toe shape.
kislik-bot: After a wet day, stuff with paper and dry at room temperature; never on a radiator.
Apply water-repellent spray at the start of each season.
Ask for a new sole when the lugs drop below 3 mm.
sneaker: Clean by hand with lukewarm water and a soft brush; no machine wash.
Remove the insole and dry it separately.
Patch the outsole heel when it wears to extend its life.
klasik: Use a shoe tree after every wear.
When the sole wears, ask for a Goodyear resole; the upper lasts for years.
cocuk: Keep the hook-and-loop straps free of lint and sand.
Send outgrown pairs to the Take Back – Reborn programme.

stepDescs.cutting: The leather is read by its grain and pieces are cut with minimal waste.
stepDescs.closing: Upper pieces are joined; twin-needle and hand stitching.
stepDescs.lasting: The upper is pulled over the last by hand and left to set; this is where the shoe takes shape.
stepDescs.sole: The sole is attached by Goodyear, Blake or cemented construction.
